subject: X11 issues with newer versions of Shiny

messages.author: eb38877790de0adf
messages.subject: X11 issues with newer versions of Shiny
parts:
Hello Shiny Happy People!

I am working on a system that does not support X11, which is causing some issues with a newer versions of Shiny.  

I have an app that works great R 2.15.1 and Shiny 0.10.0, but I get an X11 error when I run the same app on R 3.2.0 and Shiny 0.12.2.9000.  Some session information can be found below:

Successful:
> sessionInfo()
Oracle Distribution of R version 2.15.1  (--)

other attached packages:
 [1] shiny_0.10.0

X11 error:
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.0 (2015-04-16)

other attached packages:
 [1] shiny_0.12.2.9000

My suspicion is that this has to do with hovering functionality that was built into newer versions of Shiny, but I haven't been able to pinpoint exactly what about the plotOutput() is creating the X11 error.

Could anybody shed some light on what exactly is causing this issue in newer versions of Shiny and a possible way around this problem?  One idea I had was to change the Shiny app to 1) output a bitmap/pdf file instead of a renderPlot() object and 2) read this file using img() rather than plotOutput(), but I would be surprised if there isn't a more elegant way to address this issue.

Thanks!

- Derek

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: X11 issues with newer versions of Shiny
parts:
My gut feeling is that there is something wrong with your R
installation. In particular, you may have built R from source but did
not install the cairo/pango libraries properly. I think the error
message about X11 is fairly misleading (we have seen it many times in
this mailing list). It basically means the default setting for png()
does not work (see the `type` argument), and R falls back to X11. If
you use Debian/Ubuntu, you need to run apt-get build-dep r-base-dev to
install all the dependencies before you build R from source.

Regards,
Yihui
